erin: Headline: sample-app returned a single-candidate tool result wrapped in an array — TS schema validator failed in onboarding smoke.
noah: Is this from hosted or the local sample stub?
erin: Hosted playground + SDK call. Payload snippet: ```json
{"tool_result": [{"name":"normalize_phone","args":{"phone":"+1 555"}}] }
```
mira: Runtime change note: collectCandidates() now always yields arrays. We had a refactor to standardize batches.
sam: TS SDK helper does `if (!isObject(v)) throw` and so `[{...}]` trips it. Python helper is lenient.
erin: Two paths: make server return single object for n=1, or document "always array" and update SDKs.
oah: Prefer server-side contract "always array" — deterministic shapes are easier for clients and for schema tooling. SDK can add `unwrapSingleCandidate` as explicit opt-in for DX.
mira: If we pick always-array, update quickstart which currently shows object example. Also add an integration test verifying shapes for n=1 and n=3.
sam: Also found auth retry bug: after token refresh middleware occasionally JSON-stringifies `args`. Example in logs: `"args": "{\"phone\":\"+1 555\"}"`. That breaks validators.
erin: Filed RT-2075 for sampler parity and RT-2076 for auth-retry double-encode.
ci-bot: New issue RT-2075 created by erin: https://tickets.internal/RT-2075
ci-bot: New issue RT-2076 created by sam: https://tickets.internal/RT-2076
oah: Plan: 1) Add samplekit e2e asserting shape parity (ts & py). 2) Docs quickstart update. 3) SDK opt-in helper behind explicit flag. 4) Auth retry test to prevent regressions.
mira: I'll add a runtime unit test and PR to make collectCandidates respect `n_candidates===1` unwrap if we decide.
sam: I'll implement opt-in `unwrapSingleCandidate` in TS with a note in changelog and add strict-mode validator.
erin: OK. I'll update onboarding docs and sampleapp snippets. Tagging this thread on the devex board. :white_check_mark:
